text: Bitcoin is holding steady near $64.5K with minimal daily movement, while Ethereum is outperforming with a 1.7% gain, suggesting some rotational interest toward altcoins despite the broader market remaining in fear territory. The Fear & Greed index at 28 indicates genuine caution, yet Bitcoin's dominant 56.4% market share and modest $40B daily volume suggest traders are waiting rather than capitulating. Smaller caps like Solana (+2%) are catching bids, which typically signals risk appetite beginning to creep back in on the margin.
